build: Track installer binaries with Git LFS

- .msi packages in Target/debug/bundle/msi/
- .exe installers in Target/debug/bundle/nsis/

By marking these paths with LFS filters, we prevent large binary files from being stored directly in the Git repository, improving clone performance and repository size management. The configuration ensures these build artifacts are automatically handled through Git LFS during version control operations.
